notes.title: Let's party! Lacuna Anniversary Update now available!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Precisely a year ago, Lacuna launched on PC. It was DigiTales' first ever release, and we had no idea how it would go. Thankfully, its reception from both critics and players alike has been very positive. 

[h2]Thank you so much for your support, your reviews, appreciative messages, guides, achievement hunting, social media follows, and all the other nice things you've done as a community! It means the world to us.[/h2]

Today, we want to show our appreciation by bringing you [b]Community Items, Steam Deck support, and a big anniversary update[/b]!


[h2]Community Items[/h2]
We sat down and created some neat Steam Community Items for you to show off to your friends. Here's how they work in a nutshell: You earn Lacuna-themed trading cards by playing the game and by trading them on the community market with other players. Once your collection of six cards is complete, you can use them to craft a Lacuna-themed badge to show off on your Steam profile. Repeating the process levels up your badge to a maximum level of 5 (and there's a special foil badge you can earn by collecting all six rare foil cards). Crafting a badge also earns you additional Lacuna-themed random drops each time, like emojis and profile backgrounds.

[u][b]In a nutshell:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Collect the six trading cards representing some of Lacuna's main characters.
[*] Craft up to six badges to rise through the ranks at the CDI.
[*] Express yourself using the six new Lacuna emojis (including a super rare Horace)!
[*] Spice up your Steam profile using one of five Lacuna backgrounds.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/ce230d16446ef6e97fa8c638581d21791fbd71e3.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Deck support[/h2]
Valve already rated Lacuna as "Playable" on Steam Deck a while ago, which is the second-best achievable rating. Having tested it ourselves, we can confirm that the game could already be played comfortably from start to finish on the Steam Deck. However, a mouse cursor would occasionally show up, which denied us the coveted "Deck Verified" rating. We have patched this and received the Verified rating just last night! It should become visible on Lacuna's page any moment now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/572304c6fc6bd280127b8377ee1b78c56b6b1b5c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Anniversary update[/h2]
Over the past year, we received a number of bug reports and other requests for improvements, the more severe of which we usually patched in right away. However, the backlog of minor changes kept growing, and we took a few weeks out of our schedule this month to address them. These are no major content additions or new features, but the game is getting a little shinier, faster, and more robust. You can find the full list of changes at the bottom.

We want to thank you again for your support, and we hope you keep enjoying the game. As always, let us know your thoughts!

[i]Much love,
DigiTales Interactive & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/9645c065cbecb50f24a4166c7a8284e6f6304ee2.gif[/img]

[h3]Changelog[/h3]
[b]Polishing[/b]
[list]
[*] Added more camera shake & controller vibration throughout the scenes
[*] Moved away flying cars that were distracting in some scenes
[*] Stairs in Lower Precinct apartments are now opened up after finding the apartment
[*] Mitigated brief FPS drop in prologue [spoiler]panic sequence[/spoiler]
[*] Adjusted volume of some music tracks
[*] Implemented a few missing sounds
[*] Various other small fixes & improvements
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Investigatable texts now scale with camera zoom
[*] Investigatable UI canvas now scales with text length
[*] Outline Mode tooltip is no longer truncated by screen border
[*] Pulse on Cell's home tab is now set more frequently & accurately
[*] Weather icon in Cell's home tab now reflects actual weather
[*] Added Assemble news widget to main menu
[*] Improved legibility of Asian fonts using drop shadows
[*] Added missing color-coding of bank statements in Chinese
[*] Walked distance in Cell home tab no longer causes a line break when long
[*] Added Malaysian translation company to rolling credits
[*] Fixed some typos in German and English localization
[/list]

[b]New art assets[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a number of new commercials (incl. sound design)
[*] Flying cars now have a variety of colors (used to be all blue)
[*] Added proper benches to CDI HQ rooftop
[*] Thompson now holds up contract when referring to it
[*] [spoiler]Implemented dedicated 'get shot in the back' animation for Williams[/spoiler]
[*] Improved animations when [spoiler]Rattlesnake Farms door[/spoiler] is blown open
[*] Neil now leans against the wall in appropriate places
[*] Computer screen in Drovia is now animated (+ new portrait)
[*] [spoiler]Corion Church guard[/spoiler] is now seen coming out of hiding
[*] Added various 'get tied up' & 'tie up' animations throughout scenes
[*] News & cigarette machines now have their own frames in the levels
[*] Visually improved various static & animated sprites
[/list]

[b]Fixed rare/minor bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Train acceleration & deceleration are no longer FPS-dependent
[*] Player can no longer get stuck by sitting down in train right before scene change
[*] Player can no longer get soft-stuck on the [spoiler]stairs to Catherine's roof[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed incorrect render order of an [spoiler]agent in Corion Church[/spoiler]
[*] Added animations for Receptionist handing Neil the universal key card
[*] Assigned a missing portrait for agent Kumar during [spoiler]Handover[/spoiler] scene
[*] Added new kneel animations for [spoiler]Laura in Handover[/spoiler] scene
[*] Fixed jittering of sprites during (most) slow camera movements
[*] Fixed a bug where player could clip out of [spoiler]Mrs. Moore's[/spoiler] apartment
[*] Fixed a bug where camera would zoom incorrectly outside Lila's apartment
[*] Fixed a bug where Neil wouldn't put away his badge properly sometimes
[*] Fixed a bug where player was able to get up from bed early before Gary's call
[*] Fixed a bug where Matuna Harbor door would not visibly open up
[*] Corrected a line being said by the wrong person in Matuna Harbor
[/list]

notes.title: Lacuna 1.2.1 Out Now!
notes.content:
Agents!

the last update isn't too long ago, but we're still making improvements and adding new languages - which is awesome - we want to thank you all again for your support. Here's what changed in a nutshell.
[list]
[*] Added Traditional Chinese
[*] Main character no longer jitters while running
[*] Fixed a bug where quality settings would not be applied consistently
[*] Improved drop shows in all UI
[*] Many small changes, improvements & bug fixes
[/list]
And for all those who are still thinking about diving into the world of Lacuna, we teamed up with another Noir detective:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22689/Pixel_Art_Detectives_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/e6a4b3a8dd28236144d0ee9cd58447d12e8bb6db.jpg[/img][/url]

You can get this bundle now at a discounted price; just click the image and immerse yourself. 

We hope you enjoy this update. Let us know if you have any other wishes or problems to report, we read everything on this forum and every single review!

All the best,
Everyone at DigiTales & Assemble <3

notes.title: Lacuna 1.2.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
Agents!

It's been four months since Lacuna's release, and we want to thank you all again for your support. The game is about to hit 500 reviews, which is huge. Besides the positive feedback, you have provided some great suggestions for additions and improvements and voiced some complaints, too. That is why we're releasing another big update today! Here's what changed in a nutshell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/89cab4b2fe8901b17725175164ede488dcde9633.gif[/img]
[i]New CDI agents can be found all around the headquarters[/i]

[h2]Performance improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*]Vastly reduced GPU & CPU load, the game should now achieve higher FPS on weaker machines
[*]Sturdier code at low FPS, which prevents bugs when the framerate does dip
[*]Eliminated FPS drops when loading UI
[*]Eliminated animation stutter when moving
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/0904090d5473b145351a7bbb34bff207f6c2fc45.png[/img]
[i]Flag icons indicating the save game language in the selection screen[/i]

[h2]UI & settings[/h2]

[list]
[*]Text and voice language can now be set independently
[*]Language of each save game is now displayed in selection screen
[*]Added double-check for leaving settings with unsaved changes
[*]Added a 'restore defaults' button to all settings menus
[*]Improved 'progress icon' indicating different phases of an ongoing dialog
[*]Improved controls & icons for PlayStation controllers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/7b08fe5f257bff89be366ed7fdc7485717e25f15.gif[/img]
[i]The icon in the bottom right now has more states to improve legibility[/i]

[h2]Fixes and polish[/h2]

[list]
[*]Eliminated bugs where player would overshoot, glitch past, or slide down stairs
[*]Numerous new animations, new Extras, more CDI agents, and other eye candy added
[*]Fixed some text and VO errors across all languages
[*]Various small bug fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/36c04a1c2fcb34ae199ec18ef2246c2083eb7540.gif[/img]
[i]Added child Extras in parts of the city[/i]

[h2]Language update[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added Malaysian translation (text only)
[*]Traditional Chinese is coming in two weeks
[*]If you personally asked for a different language, please don't be mad that we're adding these (first)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/1b0faac602ca9f27b9ace512dc5a0ac6b3d3d0a8.gif[/img]
[i]The trains are getting a little crowded[/i]

We hope you enjoy this update. Let us know if you have any other wishes or problems to report, we read everything on this forum and every single review. We'll see you in two weeks for the addition of Traditional Chinese!

All the best,
Everyone at DigiTales & Assemble <3

notes.title: Achievements Unlocked!
notes.content:
Agents!

We are proud to announce that Lacuna 1.1.0 is now live. Among a number of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1364100/discussions/1/3115906960353187466/]smaller fixes and improvements[/url], it brings you [b]achievements[/b]!

To be perfectly honest with you, we were so busy getting the game itself ready last month that the topic of achievements didn't really cross our minds. Due to popular demand, we prioritized adding them right after enabling cloud saves (and going on a short post-launch break).

Since this is an update for all you collectors out there, we should probably add that Steam Community Items (Trading Cards, Badges, and Store Points items) will also be added down the line, but aren't part of today's patch.

[h2]'Patchable' achievements[/h2]

We did our best to make each achievement patchable, i.e. automatically grant it to all players that met the requirements to receive it before this patch. This has been possible with most of them, but some track completely new variables – more on those below.

[b]To receive all patchable achievements you (would have) previously unlocked, please start the game and load each existing save file once.[/b] In other words: Click your previously used save slot(s) in the profile selection to be taken to the main menu, and you should receive everything you're owed at once. Let us know if you're not getting any achievements you feel like you should be.

[h2]'Non-patchable' achievements[/h2]

There is also a number of [b]non-patchable[/b] achievements. These can only be unlocked in a completely new save file – or in an ongoing one if you haven't played too far already:
[list]
[*][b]Happy Boi / Chonky Boi:[/b] you haven't beaten the first level where Neil appears as the protagonist.
[*][b]Good Cop / Bad Cop[/b]: you haven't finished the Villa level yet.
[*][b]She's Got A Point[/b]: you haven't had your second conversation with [spoiler]Zora[/spoiler] yet.
[*][b]Groupie:[/b] you haven't been down to Paluhn Market twice already.
[*][b]Consumer & Couch Potato:[/b] you haven't reached any of the game's finales yet.
[*][b]afk?[/b]: you haven't beaten the game yet.
[/list]
There are more plans, both Lacuna-related and otherwise, that we can't wait to share with you. Until then, we hope that you enjoy this first larger update!

Best wishes from DigiTales Interactive & Assemble Entertainment ❤️

notes.title: Thank You! || Cloud Saves Enabled || More Updates Soon
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

Lacuna came out last Thursday, and it's been quite the week for us here at DigiTales Interactive HQ (i.e. our respective apartments thanks to the pandemic). We want to thank you all so much for buying, playing, and reviewing the game. We did [b]not[/b] expect to hit 200 reviews at over 90% positive within eight days, and it's hard to overstate how happy it makes us that the game is being received so favorably.

That being said, after release is before release!

You guys have brought up some excellent points on how to improve the game. Based on your feedback, we have already been able to find and squash a number of bugs, and there are some more we have yet to take care of. You also asked for some additional features and QoL improvements, and we're happy to oblige.

Here's the plan:
[list]
[*] [b]Cloud saves[/b] are now enabled on Steam and GOG!
[*] The big update 1.1.0 is already in the works, but it won't be done before late June. Among other things, it will bring [b]achievements[/b] to Steam and GOG.
[*] We're releasing one minor update over the weekend, which fixes some small issues and adds a little bit of extra polish. We'll let you know all about it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1364100/discussions/1/3115906960353187466/]ongoing patch notes[/url] once it's out.
[/list]
There's some other things we've been looking into based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] We are going to allow players to set VO language and subtitles language separately. I cannot promise that this will be included in 1.1.0, but it's coming.
[*] Quite a few people have been asking if the [b]Lacuna soundtrack[/b] could be made available separately in some way. We've heard you and are working this out, but we have to ask for a little more patience.
[*] We are also working out if it could be possible to reload previous levels on a save file after beating the game once. More precisely, it would probably mean that you can reset the file to one of the story's three acts. This will be tricky to implement and take a while, but I already wanted to let you know we're trying to find a way!
[*] Lastly, a quick Q&A for recurring questions: 1. Lacuna: Prologue is the first few levels of Lacuna. Your saves transfer automatically. 2. We might port the game to more platforms, no promises yet. 3. The game does not officially support Linux or older Windows versions, but might run fine on them. If the free demo Lacuna: Prologue works, the full game should work, too.
[/list]
Once the next small update is live, the dev team will go on its first short vacation for this year and will be back working on the game in mid June. Of course, we'll keep an eye on all the support channels and be here for you as usual the whole time.

Again, thank you all so much for your support!

Cheers,
[i]Julian (and greetings from everybody at DigiTales Interactive and Assemble Entertainment!)[/i]

tags.feature: Cloud saves are now enabled on Steam and GOG!
Among other things, it will bring achievements to Steam and GOG.

notes.title: Lacuna - Dev-Blogs and more
notes.content:
[b]Lacuna is set to release 2021![/b]
In the meantime, are some tech-savvy players around? 
Or are some of you even game developers of your own?

If this is the case, please find some great (dev-)blog posts written by Julian and Jasmin from DigiTales Interactive, the developers and masterminds behind Lacuna.

[b]So let’s get started:[/b]

[h3]Moving on Stairs in a 2D Side Scroller[/h3]
[url=https://digitales.games/blog/tips/stairs-movement][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/674e2ebaa1afb978daca874e5e62bdae139158a5.png[/img][/url]
[i]‚Movement on stairs has been the bane of my existence for a long time. 
I first added it to our old prototype in late 2017 and the code stayed more or less the same up until recently. It was barely good enough for our prototype, and it was never meant to stick around until release.‘[/i] -Julian, DigiTales
[u][b]More Details:[/b][/u] [url=https://digitales.games/blog/tips/stairs-movement]https://digitales.games/blog/tips/stairs-movement[/url]

[h3]Challenges in Game Writing[/h3]
[url=https://digitales.games/blog/tips/challenges-in-game-writing][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568502/3e0af66819f328985568cedb666f79707f69a4ff.jpg[/img][/url]
[i]‚In this blog article, I will outline some of the most important challenges and difficulties we have encountered so far when writing the story for our upcoming narrative game. I will get into some of the solutions we found in my upcoming posts, but I hope that today’s article will be helpful as well – it might point you to some aspects you could take a closer look at if you have the impression that your game’s story isn’t as exciting as it should be.‘[/i] -Jasmin, DigiTales
[u][b]More Details:[/b][/u] [url=https://digitales.games/blog/tips/challenges-in-game-writing]https://digitales.games/blog/tips/challenges-in-game-writing[/url]
